Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor orders relief after Doda flash floods

Flash floods occurred in the Doda district of Jammu and Kashmir. Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha has directed the local administration to provide immediate relief to the families affected by the natural disaster. The administration is tasked with ensuring prompt assistance to those impacted.
